response.justification: The candidate comfortably exceeds every technical requirement — strong TypeScript, React, Node.js, REST, SQL, plus nice-to-haves like Kubernetes, AWS, and LLM/MCP tooling experience. However, with roughly 15+ years of experience and current Staff-level standing, he is significantly overqualified for an entry-level position, raising serious concerns about salary expectations, retention, and role fit. Worth a conversation only if there is a genuine reason he wants a junior/mid IC role.
strengths: Deep TypeScript/Node.js/React experience across multiple product companies
Covers nearly all nice-to-haves: Kubernetes, AWS, LLM/MCP and agentic tooling
Proven mentorship and clean-architecture mindset (TDD, workshops, open source)
concerns: Severely overqualified for an entry-level role; likely retention and compensation mismatch
No explicit PostgreSQL or Nest.js experience (MongoDB/MySQL background instead)
Currently employed at Staff level — unclear motivation for a junior/mid position

key_factors.factor: Full coverage of required tech stack
